distribution: Debian forky/sid (copied from existing stock-kernel VM)
machine: QEMU virt, HVF cpu host, 4 vCPUs, 4G RAM
checks: GRUB loads generic kernel from image
authorized key matches host id_ed25519.pub fingerprint
SSH password and keyboard-interactive authentication disabled
machine identity and SSH host key stable across cold boots
notes: The older Asahi kernel remains an alternate menu entry, not a hardware qualification.
Image hash changes on subsequent guest writes; recorded hash identifies the tested stopped image.
Physical transfer must handle individual filesystem partitions; this image is not a host whole-disk replacement.
Apple boot stub, native kernel configuration/device tree, physical drivers and native boot remain separate.
